name: Dan Furphy
education: B.S. in finance and M.B.A., University of Wyoming
prior_offices: Wyoming House, 2017–2020; Wyoming Senate District 10, 2021–2024; Laramie City Council (as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Dan Furphy of Laramie served in the Wyoming House from 2017 to 2020 and in the Senate from 2021 to 2024, representing Senate District 10. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Jan. 15, 1951, in Laramie; listed a B.S. in finance and an M.B.A. from the University of Wyoming; and identified him as a retired banker. Civic roles listed there included the Wyoming Bankers Association, foundation boards at the University of Wyoming American Heritage Center, Laramie County Community College, and Ivinson Hospital, Laramie Rotary (as president), United Way of Albany County, and prior service on the Laramie City Council and as a trustee of Ivinson Memorial Hospital. The directory said he was married to his wife, Kandi, and had two children.
